surfaces.purpose: generic question encounter with player/Monster HP, identity, feedback and SP
surfaces.authority: server battle/review result; presentation consumes committed values

surfaces.purpose: read-only zone/boss readiness and entry CTA
surfaces.presentation_class: zone context, not a generic Monster combat card

surfaces.purpose: Lord Trial intro, ritual, result and progression context
surfaces.presentation_class: separate authority; never mapped to Battlefield Boss

surfaces.purpose: damage, correctness, attack, defeat and reward/drop presentation slots
surfaces.presentation_class: transient feedback, not an independent encounter identity

duplication_notes: Monster identity/HP is rendered by updateMonsterUI for map-battle data.
Normal /api/monster/status has a separate direct render branch.
Kill transition writes the next Monster directly instead of using one shared identity renderer. A023 decorates all three paths without changing their settlement flow.

tier_contract.without_color: visible Common label, star symbol and standard border
visible Rare label, diamond symbol and double border
visible Elite label, four-point symbol and reinforced geometry
visible Battlefield Boss label, burst symbol and heavy border

lord_trial_separation.framework_behavior: lord_trial metadata is marked separate and is never downgraded or styled as generic Battlefield Boss

base_creature_variant_contract.model: base creature family -> variant identity -> encounter presentation
base_creature_variant_contract.minimum_identity_difference: at least one meaningful silhouette/gear/pose/prop/proportion combination; hue-only swaps are rejected
base_creature_variant_contract.art_production_rule: one base family can support multiple controlled identities; final roster cardinality remains undecided

hp_presentation_contract.invalid_values: neutral dash / safe empty state, never fabricated combat value

feedback_contract.input_rule: feedback is applied only when caller marks the result committed

responsive_contract.desktop: four-column showcase / live encounter keeps player and Monster readable
responsive_contract.ipad_landscape: two-column prototype grid; battle surface retains side-by-side fighter hierarchy
responsive_contract.ipad_portrait: single-column cards; no horizontal overflow; HP and identity remain above fold
responsive_contract.mobile_390: single-column compact card with 44px-safe interaction surfaces
responsive_contract.mobile_375: single-column compact card with no clipped badge/name/HP
responsive_contract.mobile_360: single-column compact card with bounded art and wrapped supporting copy
